behavior.wind_convention: world vector (cos(degrees), 0, sin(degrees)) multiplied by signed strength, matching existing particles and flags
behavior.sail_force: horizontal world force along the rotated hull axis; sign and smooth magnitude follow the wind component along that axis
behavior.beam_wind: zero axial thrust; no discontinuous sign flip
behavior.axis_sign: either stored hull end produces the same world force
behavior.model_limits: simplified sail polar; no apparent wind, lift/trim or tacking simulation; changed wind may push a ship astern
